entry.name: jit.rubix
entry.description: jit.rubix segments a matrix into a grid of rectangular cells whose cells can be reordered, flipped both horizontally and vertically, frozen, and filled with a single color value derived from a cell in the grid area (monochromatic).

messages.description: Toggles the freeze flag for the cell specified by. If set, the cell's contents will be frozen.

messages.name: hflip
messages.description: Toggles the horizontal flip flag for the cell specified by. If set, the cell's contents will be flipped horizontally.

messages.name: mono
messages.digest: Fill the cell with the upper left corner cell's color
messages.description: Toggles the mono flag for the cell specified by. If set, the cell's contents will be all the same value as the upper left most value in cell.

messages.name: nomono
messages.digest: Disable mono mode for a cell
messages.description: Toggles the nomono flag for the cell specified by. If set, the cell's contents will not be monochromatic even if probmono has a non-zero value.
